price_spread.formula_spread: per representative (year, day): max_p c_p - min_p c_p, and mean of the top-4 hourly prices minus mean of the bottom-4 (h = E/P = 4 h); averaged with weight num_years * num_days (undiscounted) and, separately, with the model block weight num_years * num_days / 1.02^(y-2025).
price_spread.formula_captured: captured spread [EUR/MWh per full cycle] = (V / E) / EFC_horizon, EFC_horizon = sum_y 365 * num_years * EFC/day_y (full equivalent cycles of the nameplate E over the 15 years; Z2 EFC, cell-side throughput / (2 E))

result.formula: W19's Z3 formula, reused: Q_y = sum over the TSO block and the three DSO blocks of every day of year y of the gross settlement-excluded per-block cost (sum of generation_cost + flexibility_cost_internal + load_curtailment_cost + res_curtailment_penalty + ess_usage_cost + detector_penalty_total, as recorded in component_levels_terminal.json); undiscounted Q_y = sum of unweighted * num_years * num_days; V_y = Q_y(0) - Q_y(x); V(r) = sum_y V_y_undiscounted / (1 + r)^(y - 2025); value_to_cost(r) = V(r) / I(x); value - I = V(r) - I(x). Production applies ONE discount factor per representative year to all 5 years of the block (W19 Z3 production_convention); I(x) is paid in 2025 and not discounted.
